# Millionærklubben Eksklusiv: Investeringsmuligheder for resten af 2026 - hvilken vej blæser de finansielle vinde? Del 2

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-08-31  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is part 2 of a Danish Millionærklubben panel (Otto Friedriksen, Henrik Drusebjerg, Lars Persson) looking at investment opportunities for the rest of 2026. The panel praises the record earnings season but disagrees on AI. Drusebjerg thinks the AI boom is only beginning and favours equal-weight S&P 500 and broad energy ETFs. Persson worries about over-investment and cross-ownership among the big US tech companies. Friedriksen says Nvidia's gross margin, not revenue growth, is the key watch-point. The panel also covers electrification, energy and commodities (NKT, Vestas, miners), gold, climate, tourism stocks (Scandic, Skistar), and whether Danish equities such as Novo are attractive; Drusebjerg criticises Danish home bias.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest Lars Persson bought Vestas because it was beaten down; an electrification play despite Chinese competition.

#### Reasoning

Persson has a personal position and sees Vestas as a contrarian, beaten-down way to play electrification. He admits the Chinese competition risk (as happened with solar) and has no strong conviction on valuation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese turbine makers take over the wind market as they did solar
- if margins erode from price competition

> *"Altså jeg har jo købt Vestas, fordi jeg synes jo, det var en, der var bumpet."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Otto: the earnings report tomorrow hinges on gross margin and the Rubin ramp, not the headline growth rate.

#### Reasoning

Guest Otto Friedriksen sees Nvidia as a market champion whose moat is the key question. Pressure on gross margin, competition or Chinese alternatives could end its champion status. Drusebjerg prefers equal-weight exposure to reduce reliance on Nvidia.

#### Sell Triggers

- if gross margin compresses
- if Rubin production cannot meet demand
- if Chinese competition matches Western hardware

> *"Hvordan ser bruttomagien ud? Ser vi en konkurrence, der kommer ind og udfordrer det meget, meget lukrative marked"*

---

### 🟠 NKT — NKT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Electrification winner that looks expensive but has growth; watch margins as it builds new factories.

#### Reasoning

Lars says expensive can still be cheap given the growth. The risk is that further factory capex pushes margins down and disappoints investors, as happened with Coloplast.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new factory investments compress margins

> *"så kan det være, at deres indtjeningsmaginer kommer under pres"*

---

### 🟠 SHOT — Scandic Hotels | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Lars suggests watching Nordic hotels as heat pushes tourists north.

#### Reasoning

A speculative climate and tourism theme: hotter southern European summers could send more tourists to the Nordics and keep Nordic holidaymakers at home. Lars explicitly frames it as something to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the tourism inflow fails to materialise

> *"man kunne godt købe måske, holde øje med hoteller eller hele underholdningssektoren i Nordeuropa"*

---

### 🟠 SKIS-B — SkiStar | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Using its cabins in summer too; benefits from the northbound tourism theme.

#### Reasoning

Lars names SkiStar as a beneficiary of summer tourism shifting north. Its year-round use of cabins adds to the thesis. Speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if summer occupancy does not improve

> *"Scandic Hotels, Skistar, som bruger deres hytter nu også om sommeren"*

---

### ⛔ NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Otto: pricing pressure and dependence on one product; foreign investors prefer Lilly.

#### Reasoning

Supply and demand in obesity drugs have come into balance, which pressures prices and earnings. Novo depends on one product while Lilly is more diversified. Otto says a good story needs good investment timing. His stance is cautious, not a clear sell.

> *"Men Nuvo er gået fra insulin og andre produkter til i høj grad at være meget afhængig af fedme og det ene produkt"*

---
